title: Anthropic Defaults Paid Claude Plans to Auto Mode
summary:
Subscribers to Pro, Max, and Team tiers will no longer be required to manually confirm every step of an AI session starting next week. Anthropic is transitioning sessions across the Claude web, desktop, and mobile applications to a default "auto mode," where the assistant uses an internal safety classifier to block risky actions rather than requesting user approval for each move.

The shift follows a rollout for Claude Code on August 14, during which testing showed auto mode's classifier caught 89% of dangerous commands compared to just 14% caught via manual approval. Users who prefer the previous workflow can switch back to manual permissioning at any time.
